label: training-gym-r57-complete
context:
Training Gym R57 completed! ALL 4 CLEAN ON FIRST TRY!

R57 RESULTS (all 10/10, all clean):
1. treap-001 (T8) - Treap: random priority, BST on keys, max-heap on priorities. Insert with rotations, delete by rotating down.
2. dijkstra-001 (T7) - Dijkstra with heapq. Lazy deletion (skip if d > dist[u]). Path reconstruction via prev[].
3. radix-sort-001 (T6) - LSD radix sort with counting sort subroutine. Stable, O(d*(n+k)).
4. topk-heap-001 (T6) - Top-K using min-heap of size k. O(n log k). Max-heap trick for smallest by negating.

DB: 271 exercises, 467 attempts, avg 9.89, 94.4% perfect. 215 passed.
23+ consecutive rounds all 10/10.
decisions: Treap delete: rotate higher-priority child up, then recursively delete from opposite subtree
Dijkstra: lazy deletion with d > dist[u] check. prev[] for path reconstruction.
Radix sort: counting sort by digit. Build cumulative count, place right-to-left for stability.
Top-K largest: min-heap of size k, heapreplace when new > min. Top-K smallest: negate for max-heap trick.
next_steps: Design R58 exercises. Try: Bellman-Ford, Floyd-Warshall, topological sort, or A* search.
